near_bed_velocity_type.description: 'soulsby' = Soulsby 2011 formulation, 'lewis' = Lewis 2017 formulation, 'depth_averaged' = depth-averaged velocity

freedom_factor.description: initial state of Freedom Factor (0 = trapped, 1 = free)

gamma_e.description: long-term equilibrium proportion of free particles

b_e.description: maximum free-to-trapped transition probability per second [1/s]

particle_state_type.description: 'trapped' = particle is trapped, 'free' = particle is free

reference_date.description: reference date used by the timeseries in the input data model, e.g., '2020-01-01 00'. If empty, then the reference is set to Unix epoch (1970-01-01 00:00:00)

morfac.description: morphological acceleration factor for time decompression (default: 1 = no decompression)

fm_format_type.description: Format of the D-Flow FM model output files. 'sedtrails_nc' is the default format for Sedtrails.

preprocess.description: true: pre-process; false: use existing files with default names

input_model.description: input model for the simulations (supported formats: fm_netcdf, xbeach, sfincs)

report_domain_exit_updates.description: If true, log per-timestep messages when particles newly leave the domain or beach on land. Final domain-exit and beaching summaries are controlled by the CLI report-domain-exits option.

data.description: path to the input flow-field data file

read_interval.description: time chunk size for reading input data; e.g., '30D12H25M0S' for 30 days, 12 hours, and 25 minutes.

repeat_eulerian_fields.description: If true, Eulerian flow fields repeat from the first input timestamp after simulation time exceeds the forcing time range. If false, the final available fields are reused.

comp_dir.description: path to directory where complementary validation data is stored

subset_x.description: X coordinates to limit the extent of the domain. Given as minimum:maximum, e.g. 35000:52000

subset_y.description: Y coordinates to limit the extent of the domain. Given as minimum:maximum, e.g. 12000:150000

pol_file.description: path to Detares a '.pol' file contatining geometries definitions for the domain of interest.

inner_boundary_pol_files.description: paths to Deltares/Tekal '.pol' files containing island or cutout polygons to exclude from the active particle-tracking mesh.

open.description: paths to Deltares/Tekal '.pol' files containing polygons that select active boundary edges to classify as open/offshore boundaries.

land.description: paths to Deltares/Tekal '.pol' files containing polygons that select active boundary edges to classify as land/cutout boundaries.

boundary_class_pol_files.description: User override polygons for active boundary edge classes. Edge midpoints inside these polygons are classified by boundary class.

fm.description: format of the D-Flow FM model output files. 'sedtrails_nc' is the default format for Sedtrails.

start.description: initial starttime for sedtrails simulation, e.g., datetime with format 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss'. If omitted, then simulation starts at the beginning of the Flow-filed time series.

duration.description: total duration for the simulation, e.g., '0D12H25M0S' for 12 hours and 25 minutes. If omitted, then simulation runs until the end of the Flow-field time series.

timestep.description: timestep for the simulation, e.g., '30S' for 30 seconds.

cfl_condition.description: CFL condition for adaptive timestep calculation. If 0, timestep is not adapted.

kinematic_viscosity.description: kinematic viscosity [m2/s]; (valid for Temp = 10 degC and salinity = 35 ppt, p. 26-27)

rho_w.description: water density [kg/m3] (valid for Temp = 10 degC and salinity = 35 ppt, p. 26-27)

friction_angle.description: friction angle of sediment (30 deg default)

diffusion_coefficient.description: random walk diffusion coefficient (horizontal diffusivity K_h)

bertin_coefficient.description: Empirical coefficient c in the Bertin (2008) mixing layer formula: d_mix = c * sqrt(max(tau_max - tau_cr, 0)) [m / (N/m^2)^0.5]. Default 0.041 matches the original publication.

mod_file.description: file containing bed shear stress time series to add to data (in a spatially constant, time-varying manner). If empty, then no bed shear stress is added.

calculate.description: Controls if local bedslope in x and y directions should be calculated

resolution.description: resolution to which bedslope should be reinterpolated

bedslope_check_plot.description: if true, it creates a check plot to make sure bedslopes are in the right direction

bedslope_caxis_factor.description: factor for tuning colour axis in check plot (i.e., 1/caxisFactor =1/100 => shows slopes of 1/100)

bedslope_alpha_bs.description: longitudinal bedslope transport effect tuning factor

bedslope_alpha_bn.description: transverse bedslope transport effect tuning factor

populations.description: list of particle populations to simulate.

save_interval.description: save interval for output files, e.g., '1H' for 1 hour.

sync_interval.description: optional cadence for flushing streaming NetCDF output to disk. Defaults to outputs.save_interval. Use a longer interval to reduce filesystem sync overhead.

store_tracks.description: store full particle tracks; set false for compact final-state output

directory.description: path to directory for storing the results of the simulation

coordinate_dtype.description: floating point precision for trajectory coordinate variables

status_dtype.description: integer precision for trajectory status flag variables

compression.description: compress chunked NetCDF variables: true, false, or auto based on estimated output size

compression_auto_threshold_mb.description: estimated uncompressed output size in MiB at which compression auto mode enables compression

compression_level.description: zlib compression level for NetCDF output; 0 disables compression

shuffle.description: enable HDF5 shuffle filter when NetCDF compression is enabled

time_chunk.description: number of saved timesteps per NetCDF chunk

particle_chunk.description: number of particles per NetCDF chunk

sync_interval.description: flush NetCDF output every N saved samples; 0 flushes only on close

reopen_interval.description: proactively close and reopen NetCDF output every N saved samples; null or 0 disables this

checkpoint.description: write a compact sedtrails_checkpoint.nc restart file

checkpoint_interval.description: refresh checkpoint every N saved samples; 0 writes only the final checkpoint

store_end_positions.description: store only the last position of each particle at the end of the simulation
